name: بقايا حلم
overview: The events revolve around Maryam and her husband Adel and her suffering from her inability to have children, so she proposes to Adel to marry Hala so that he can achieve his dream, and on the other hand, Fares vows to take revenge on Maryam for refusing to marry him and favoring Adel over him, so he agrees with the employee Ibrahim to disclose information about a business deal for Adel's company in exchange for his treatment of his young daughter Amal, but things develop and many things unfold for everyone.
